lines.text: U-li-ni-gi-dv-no du-ne-tse-le du-nv-s-da-de-le gi-lo u-do-le-ho-hi-s-di-yi na-s-gi; a-le u-ne-tse-go-hu-s-di u-li-s-da-yv-di u-ni-ne-di-yi.
lines.english: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
lines.emitted_text: ulhanikitvnho tunetsel tunvhstatelv khilo utolehohihstiy nvhski ale unhetse kohuhsti uhstayvhti uninhehtiye
